name: [teacher][open] need something students can be checked on

messages.content: Make this teachable — we need something students can be checked on, not only materials.
The opening is too thin. Write it like a textbook with a Definition callout.
Ship a read-only copy students can open on lectern.click.

name: [teacher][open] work on a different saved draft
